definitions.explanation: The act of sliding or gliding along a surface. Most commonly used for aircraft taxiing on a runway, but also for skiing and skating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{滑走|かっそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
⟦{滑走路|かっそうろ}→滑走路：05980_kassouro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧{滑走|かっそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦スキー→スキー：03849_sukii⟧{場|じょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゲレンデ→ゲレンデ：23907_gerende⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちよく→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧{滑走|かっそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I glided pleasantly down the ski slope.

notes:
Composed of {滑|かっ} (slide/glide) and {走|そう} (run). The word covers any smooth sliding movement along a surface, but is most strongly associated with aircraft and skiing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{滑走路|かっそうろ}→滑走路：05980_kassouro⟧: runway
- {滑走|かっそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to glide, to taxi
- {滑走|かっそう}⟦{距離|きょり}→距離：05331_kyori⟧: gliding/taxiing distance
- {滑走|かっそう}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧: taxiing speed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{滑|すべ}る→滑る：01230_suberu⟧: to slide/slip — the everyday verb for sliding; {滑走|かっそう} is more formal and implies sustained, purposeful movement
- ⟦{走行|そうこう}→走行：14260_soukou⟧: running/traveling — movement of vehicles on roads, not gliding
- ⟦{離陸|りりく}→離陸：05981_ririku⟧: takeoff — the act of leaving the ground, which follows {滑走|かっそう}
